dependencies_require: completed artifacts; record partial-source gaps explicitly
execution_policy: Continue harmless reads, local drafting and bounded tests without routine prompts. Record blockers and continue independent ready tasks. Stop before external writes, paid jobs, publication, merge, access changes or excluded implementations.

tasks.title: Refresh actual repository snapshots
tasks.acceptance: Record exact current main/task SHAs for all accessible repositories; log unavailable refs without inventing them.

tasks.title: Read actual instructions and schema
tasks.acceptance: Record inspected paths/revisions; do not reconstruct a missing contract from chat summaries.

tasks.title: Inventory public scientific and execution claims
tasks.acceptance: Exact text, source revision, evidence tier and proposed disposition for high-impact claims; no public edits.

tasks.title: Inspect notebook code separately from outputs
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish actually loaded code/data/models from illustrations; explicitly mark partial reads and truncation.

tasks.title: Audit execution provenance
tasks.acceptance: Stored outputs, author-reported runs and independent reproductions remain separate; no automatic execution of embedded code.

tasks.title: Draft focused public-claim corrections
tasks.acceptance: Each proposed correction links to a claim ID and preserves supported achievements; no invented credentials or live edits.

tasks.title: Verify retrieval identifiers and versions
tasks.acceptance: Primary source identity, version, exact support, code availability and limits for the named retrieval methods.

tasks.title: Check retrieval equations and mechanisms
tasks.acceptance: Record source-located definitions, direction and normalization; separate exact paper method, generic baseline and new combination.

tasks.title: Review library feasibility and security caveats
tasks.acceptance: Inspect licenses, exact install paths, API/data requirements and reference-server warnings; no installs or service exposure.

tasks.title: Freeze benign retrieval protocol
tasks.acceptance: Fictional civilian corpus, fixed evidence labels, held-out question families, budget units and failure metrics defined before comparison.

tasks.title: Build minimal offline measurement contracts
tasks.acceptance: Generic evidence, temporal and version checks have positive/negative fixtures; no external-framework branding or model calls.

tasks.title: Run and challenge finite fixtures
tasks.acceptance: Actual commands, environment, outcomes and failures recorded; bounded retries; no benchmark or production-efficacy claim.

tasks.title: Reconcile context-budget comparisons
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish tokenizer tokens, bytes and words; record reader/modality/budget differences rather than inventing matched scores.

tasks.title: Check historical-memory semantics
tasks.acceptance: Future-learned facts excluded from historical knowledge queries; superseded versions retained; generic fixtures are not Graphiti reproduction.

tasks.title: Audit civilian fly reproduction route
tasks.acceptance: Exact tutorial/API/revision, inputs and actual execution tier established; no drone-control or universal transfer implementation.

tasks.title: Audit visual-model scope
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish representation learning, episode adaptation and author benchmarks; no unmeasured under-15-second/hardware-fit claim.

tasks.title: Verify Estonian ASR model updates
tasks.acceptance: Original versus -2604 revisions/licences and civilian evaluation evidence; no model download or noisy-radio performance assumption.

tasks.title: Build hardware evidence matrix
tasks.acceptance: Exact SKU and source settings; capacity distinct from available memory and timing; unknown measurements remain null.

tasks.title: Review human-oversight evidence
tasks.acceptance: Separate general research, actual incident post-mortems and proposed interventions; log negative searches without claiming absence.

tasks.title: Prepare candidate graph mapping
tasks.acceptance: Inspect current schema before mapping; L0 at most 18 words, evidence linked, unknowns null, no automatic promotion.

tasks.title: Build candidate-facing evidence summary
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish delivered/planned, upstream/personal contribution and reported/executed; career assertions require user confirmation.

tasks.title: Challenge conclusions and preserve contradictions
tasks.acceptance: Check strongest claims and denominators; preserve disagreements; self-review is not an independent second agent.

tasks.title: Prepare scoped patch and manifests
tasks.acceptance: Declared additions-only paths, hashes and application-check scope; no secrets, raw private histories or external writes.

tasks.title: Deliver final review packet
tasks.acceptance: Completed/blocked tasks, evidence, actual tests, limits, patch and exact human decisions bundled; no false background-execution claim.
